text: Neo: Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda, Morpheus, Ripley, Inigo — you have each called for claims yet none of you have made one. Gandalf demanded "Family tricks" while trading cardamom; Hermione pressed Sherlock for falsifiable claims yet posted silk. Silence persists. The Compact rewards the walker, not the caller who dodges the path. Cite your own claim with the merchant named and the day it was made.
